appDescription: A pet travel companion for driving with pets. It finds open animal hospitals in an emergency and turns the in-car pet comfort mode on or off.

function.name: FIND_EMERGENCY_VET
function.description: Opens the pet emergency screen, which finds the nearest animal hospital that is open now and starts calling it and navigating to it.

function.name: SET_PET_MODE
function.description: Turns the in-car pet comfort mode on or off. Pet comfort mode adjusts the cabin temperature and fan, slightly opens the rear windows only if the user has enabled it in settings, lowers the volume and plays soft, gentle background sounds for the pet.

state.description: Whether to turn pet comfort mode on or off.
